senses.def: A South Korean subculture emphasizing idealized beauty, in particular large, round eyes and softened features.

ex: These lenses are also made popular by ulzzangs (얼짱), which means “best face.”

[…] We met on a language exchange
app, me the English teacher who'd swooped into
Hongdae like a sudden wind, her the ulzzang who
dreamed of opening a BBQ restaurant in America.
